title: Quasi-coherent projection data
statement: For a proper noetherian morphism, the direct image, unit, and derived pullback tensor objects have quasi-coherent cohomology.

proof.text: Properness implies quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness. Apply schemeDerivedDirectImage_preserves_QCoh to each quasi-coherent object to obtain hRf.

Obtain a quasi-coherent object U isomorphic to the tensor unit from exists_compact_derivedTensorUnit. Apply each homology functor to this isomorphism and transport quasi-coherence by prop_of_iso to obtain hO.

Apply the pullback clause of derivedPullback_tensor_preserve_QCoh to K, then canonical_derivedTensor_preserve_QCoh to its pullback and E. This yields hTensor; assemble hRf, hO and the two occurrences of hTensor.

lean.statement: theorem smoothProper_qcoh_data {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] [∀ U : Y.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))] : ∃ (hRf : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X, schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E.obj)) (hO : schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y))) (hTensor : ∀ (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X), schemeDerivedQCohProperty X (((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj) ⊗ E.obj)), ∀ (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X), schemeDerivedQCohProperty X (((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj) ⊗ E.obj)
